title: Pay a simultaneous sparse-pattern event before restarting on a future-selected configuration
statement: A literal finite union of all-wrong events over all<=floor(n/4096)initial sets places the supremum INSIDE probability. The initial set may then depend on the future primitive schedule. A future-selected retained bit costs another factor2. The construction pays its smaller density/rate and exponent; it is not a free reuse of a marginal deterministic-start bound.
